inv.desc_es:
¡ATENCIÓN INVERSORES, LOCAL COMERCIAL EN RENTABILIDAD!

DIRECTAMENTE LOS PROPIETARIOS DEL LOCAL, SIN COMISIÓN DE AGENCIA.

Alquilado a Naturgy con importantes garantías entregadas.

Magnífico local en pleno barrio de Guindalera, a escasos metros del intercambiador de Avenida de América, por lo que cuenta con un alto tránsito peatonal y rodado.

Con una superficie de 170 m2 repartidos en dos plantas (106 m2 planta baja y 64 m2 bajo rasante).

Rodeado de comercios de importantes marcas de restauración, supermercados, hoteles, entidades bancarias, restaurantes y oficinas, entre otros.

Actualmente PROIPISA dispone de una cartera de inmuebles en alquiler y venta, que engloba diversas tipologías (residencial, locales comerciales, oficinas, industrial, suelo urbano.
inv.desc_en:
INVESTORS ATTENTION! Magnificent premises IN PROFITABILITY of 4,65% per year.

Rented to a very good company dedicated to the organization and celebration of sports bets, lotteries and other recreational games.

The place is elegantly decorated and completely renovated.

With an area of 170 m2 spread over two floors (106 m2 ground floor and 64 m2 below ground).

Surrounded by shops such as supermarkets, hotels, banks, restaurants and offices.

Close to the Avenida de América interchange, with a lot of pedestrian and road traffic.

It would be managed directly with the property, without intermediation or commissions from real estate agents.

PROIPISA currently has a portfolio of properties for rent and sale, which includes various types (residential, commercial premises, offices, industrial, urban land.
